parameters.query: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgcrypto;

-- content_jobs
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS content_jobs (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  job_id VARCHAR(120) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  site_key VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
  operation VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
  status VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
  source_language VARCHAR(10),
  target_languages JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
  drive_folder_id VARCHAR(255),
  manifest_file_id VARCHAR(255),
  content_id VARCHAR(255),
  preview_urls JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  published_urls JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  scheduled_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  requested_by VARCHAR(120),
  approval_required BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
  approved_by VARCHAR(120),
  approved_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  idempotency_key VARCHAR(255) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  retry_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  last_error TEXT,
  lock_key VARCHAR(255),
  lock_expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  completed_at TIMESTAMPTZ
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_content_jobs_site_key ON content_jobs (site_key);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_content_jobs_status ON content_jobs (status);

-- job_events
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS job_events (
  id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  job_id VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL,
  event_type VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
  workflow_name VARCHAR(120),
  execution_id VARCHAR(120),
  payload JSONB,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_job_events_job_id ON job_events (job_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_job_events_created_at ON job_events (created_at);

-- content_revisions
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS content_revisions (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  job_id VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL,
  content_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  revision_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  language VARCHAR(10),
  snapshot JSONB NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_content_revisions_content_id ON content_revisions (content_id);

-- media_assets
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS media_assets (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  job_id VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL,
  asset_key VARCHAR(160) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  asset_type VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
  source_drive_file_id VARCHAR(255),
  source_url TEXT,
  final_url TEXT,
  media_id VARCHAR(255),
  language VARCHAR(10),
  width INTEGER,
  height INTEGER,
  file_size_bytes BIGINT,
  mime_type VARCHAR(100),
  checksum VARCHAR(128),
  approval_status VARCHAR(30) DEFAULT 'pending',
  consent_status VARCHAR(30),
  used_in_content_id VARCHAR(255),
  used_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_media_assets_job_id ON media_assets (job_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_media_assets_type ON media_assets (asset_type);

-- site_configs
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS site_configs (
  site_key VARCHAR(80) PRIMARY KEY,
  environment VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
  base_url TEXT NOT NULL,
  api_base_url TEXT NOT NULL,
  default_language VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL,
  supported_languages JSONB NOT NULL,
  brand_config JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  publishing_policy JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  iframe_allowlist JSONB DEFAULT '[]',
  active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

SELECT table_name
FROM information_schema.tables
WHERE table_schema = 'public'
  AND table_name IN ('content_jobs','job_events','content_revisions','media_assets','site_configs')
ORDER BY table_name;

INSERT INTO site_configs
  (site_key, environment, base_url, api_base_url, default_language, supported_languages, brand_config, publishing_policy, iframe_allowlist, active)

parameters.content:
Automation DB Setup
Run once (safe to re-run) to build the independent operational PostgreSQL schema for the content automation system. Uses the the existing PostgreSQL credential selected in n8n.

Schema + verification
02 enables pgcrypto (non-fatal if the provider forbids it — gen_random_uuid needs it on older Postgres).
03 creates the 5 tables with CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS in one transaction.
04 verifies via information_schema. 05 seeds the development test site_config (dev URLs only). 06 returns the normalized response and lists any missing tables.
